name: Nihongo Master v1.1.0 (3D Godot & Blender Edition)
changelog: v1.1.0: Added 3D Hiragana Card Game powered by Godot 4.7 and Blender 5.2! Integrated directly into the main menu with smooth transitions, 3D casino felt table, rounded playing cards, multi-button gamepad support (A/B/X/D-pad/shoulders), and dynamic 3-set progressive gauntlet.
